candidates.name: Practice guide 39: rectification and indemnity
candidates.fact: Current guidance distinguishes alteration from rectification under the Land Registration Act 2002.
candidates.limit: A suspected map mismatch is recorded as evidence for review and is not silently treated as corrected geometry.

candidates.name: Practice guide 68: amending deeds
candidates.fact: The guide was last updated 1 June 2026.
candidates.limit: Deed correction, register alteration and terrain-source correction remain separate evidence paths.

candidates.name: Alteration (PG83) collection
candidates.fact: PG83 explains purposes for which the register may be altered under Schedule 4 to the Land Registration Act 2002.
candidates.limit: Register-alteration authority does not create or validate elevation observations.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer Technical Specification
candidates.fact: The product uses identifiable persistent features with feature lifecycles tied to real-world change.
candidates.limit: Topographic feature identity is horizontal/contextual evidence, not a terrain-height measurement.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer product themes
candidates.fact: Real-world objects are represented in surveyed position where possible.
candidates.limit: Generalised topographic geometry is not promoted to cadastral or exact parcel geometry.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer feature types
candidates.fact: GM_Point coordinates are easting/northing in metres in British National Grid.
candidates.limit: Geometry-type conformance does not imply legal-boundary or elevation correctness.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Change-Only Update overview
candidates.fact: Change-Only Update contains inserts, updates and departed features.
candidates.limit: COU lineage must not be interpreted as a complete historical geometry archive.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer release notes index
candidates.fact: The release-note index identifies current and previous releases and known-data-issue links.
candidates.limit: FVDS validates holding completeness, not terrain height or legal boundary position.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap TopographicArea
candidates.fact: TopographicArea represents polygon-based topographic objects.
candidates.limit: TopographicArea polygons are contextual topography, not title polygons.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Topography Layer product supply
candidates.fact: Available formats include GeoPackage, vector tiles and GML.
candidates.limit: Supply cadence is freshness evidence and does not imply a specific feature changed.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap product supply mechanism and options
candidates.fact: Initial supply and Change-Only Update are distinct supply modes.
candidates.limit: Cross-product synchronicity supports lineage only; it does not improve elevation accuracy.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap updating data holdings
candidates.fact: The underlying Topography Layer database undergoes continuous revision.
candidates.limit: Load date, extraction date and feature-version date must not be conflated.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap feature lifecycles and tracking change
candidates.fact: Feature version date records when a new version was created.
candidates.limit: Feature-version history is lineage evidence and is not a survey-date substitute.

candidates.name: OS OpenMap Local Technical Specification
candidates.fact: OS OpenMap Local is designed as contextual street-level mapping.
candidates.limit: Context mapping is not accepted as exact parcel geometry or elevation source.

candidates.name: OS Open TOID Documentation
candidates.fact: OS Open TOID publishes persistent identifiers with a generalised location extracted from OS MasterMap products.
candidates.limit: Open TOID locations are not used as parcel boundaries or raster sample points.

candidates.name: OS Open TOID Overview
candidates.fact: Point locations are rounded to the nearest metre.
candidates.limit: Generalised Open TOID points are forbidden as exact sampling coordinates.

candidates.name: OS Open TOID Product Details
candidates.fact: Open TOID includes identifiers from Topography, Sites and Highways feature types.
candidates.limit: Identifier location is a join aid only and not a substitute for source geometry.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Sites Layer Technical Specification
candidates.fact: Sites Layer integrates with other OS MasterMap layers using common coordinate systems and identifiers.
candidates.limit: Integration metadata does not establish legal site ownership extent or terrain elevation.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Sites Layer Documentation
candidates.fact: Sites Layer provides maintained extents for functional locations such as schools, hospitals and infrastructure sites.
candidates.limit: Functional-site extent is not a registered-title boundary.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Sites Layer Getting Started Guide
candidates.fact: Sites Layer can be supplied nationally or in 5 km tiles.
candidates.limit: Tile duplication/overlap behavior must not be interpreted as duplicate legal sites.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Functional Site Extent
candidates.fact: Functional sites are geolocated polygons representing collective function or activity.
candidates.limit: Functional site polygons are excluded from cadastral parcel sampling.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Sites access point overview
candidates.fact: Access points are captured as point features associated with a functional site.
candidates.limit: Access points are navigation/context features and not exact parcel vertices.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Imagery Layer Technical Specification
candidates.fact: The product is orthorectified aerial photography for general business use.
candidates.limit: Imagery is visual/horizontal evidence and not the primary numeric terrain raster.

candidates.name: OS MasterMap Imagery Layer Documentation
candidates.fact: The imagery product is updated quarterly in February, May, August and November.
candidates.limit: Image currency and appearance are separate from bare-earth height accuracy.

candidates.name: Building Height Attribute Overview
candidates.fact: BHA is an enhancement to OS MasterMap Topography Layer for buildings and selected structures.
candidates.limit: Building-height attribution is excluded from primary ground height-difference measurement.

candidates.name: Building Height Attribute feature type
candidates.fact: BHA records the source TopographicArea TOID.
candidates.limit: Process date and TOID version are lineage controls, not survey accuracy guarantees.

candidates.name: Building Height Attribute product supply information
candidates.fact: BHA is supplied as CSV and refreshed every six months.
candidates.limit: Tile duplication must not be interpreted as multiple distinct buildings or measurements.

candidates.name: Building Height Attribute Getting Started Guide
candidates.fact: BHA is derived from and dependent on multiple other data sources.
candidates.limit: Derived building heights are diagnostic/context only for this parcel terrain workflow.

candidates.name: Building Height Attribute October 2025 release note
candidates.fact: Some Topography Layer building TOIDs can have no corresponding BHA value because of update-cycle differences or failed quality validation.
candidates.limit: Missing BHA is not interpreted as zero building height or zero terrain difference.

candidates.name: Building Height Attribute product data
candidates.fact: BHA is derived from source DTM and DSM data.
candidates.limit: One-decimal storage/derivation is not a parcel DTM accuracy guarantee.

candidates.name: Building Height Attribute product details
candidates.fact: BHA source DTMs represent bare ground while DSMs represent elevated surfaces.
candidates.limit: BHA's building-footprint derivation is not substituted for parcel-wide EA DTM sampling.

candidates.name: Common Query Language CQL2 1.0
candidates.fact: CQL2 1.0.0 is an official OGC implementation standard.
candidates.limit: Filter grammar conformance does not validate the geometry or elevation values returned.

candidates.name: OGC API Features Part 3 Filtering
candidates.fact: Part 3 extends OGC API Features with enhanced filtering using CQL2.
candidates.limit: Filtering must be explicit and reproducible; selected features are not assumed numerically correct solely because the filter is valid.
